en.name: Rockfish
en.summary: Rockfish covers a large family of lean, firm-fleshed reef and bottom fish sold whole or as fillets. From purchase they keep 1–2 days in the fridge and 4–8 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: Rockfish has no room-temperature life. Lean fish has no fat to buffer it, and whole rockfish in particular deteriorates from the gut outwards if it has not been cleaned. Bring it home cold, and follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if it is above 32 °C (90 °F). Mind the spines when you handle it: many rockfish have sharp dorsal spines, and a few species carry venom in them, which is a wound problem rather than a food-safety one.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, gutted, on ice, in a container that catches the melt water, and cook it within 1–2 days from purchase. Have the stall gut and scale it on the day. Rockfish flesh is firm and holds up better than a soft white fish, but the belly cavity is still where spoilage starts, so store it cleaned and dry rather than whole and wet. Keep it on the bottom shelf, below anything ready to eat.
en.freezer: Rockfish keeps 4–8 months at −18 °C (0 °F). The firm lean flesh freezes well and thaws with its texture largely intact, which is more than can be said for softer white fish. Wrap fillets airtight with no air pockets, or ice-glaze them by dipping in cold water and freezing the film that forms; freeze flat in meal-sized portions and label the date. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality, and dryness is what ends it.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight on a plate, or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter or in warm water. Pat dry, cook promptly, and do not refreeze raw fish.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell rather than a clean sea one.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed instead of springing back.
Cloudy sunken eyes and grey-brown gills on a whole fish.
A sticky, milky film on the fillet or liquid pooling underneath.
tips: Have it gutted and scaled at the stall; the cavity is where spoilage starts.
Watch the dorsal spines when handling a whole fish.
Ice-glaze fillets before freezing for the longest quality.
Keep the frame for stock — rockfish bones make an excellent one.

faq.q: How long does rockfish keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, gutted and on ice.
Yes, 4–8 months at −18 °C. The firm lean flesh freezes and thaws better than most white fish.
Some species have venom in the dorsal spines, so handle a whole fish carefully. It is a wound risk, not a food-safety one — the flesh is unaffected.

faq.q: How can you tell if rockfish has gone off?
faq.a: A sour or ammoniacal smell, dull sunken eyes, a sticky film on the fillet, or flesh that will not spring back.

zh.name: 石斑類岩礁魚
zh.summary: Rockfish 泛指一大群低脂、肉質結實的岩礁與底棲魚，整條或魚片販售都有。從購買日起冷藏可放 1～2 天，冷凍 4～8 個月。
zh.pantry: 這類魚沒有室溫保存這回事。低脂魚沒有脂肪當緩衝，而整條沒清理的魚更是從腹腔開始壞。請保冷帶回家，守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。處理時要小心背鰭硬棘：不少岩礁魚的背棘很尖，少數種類還帶毒，那是外傷風險而不是食品安全問題。
zh.fridge: 去內臟後鋪冰，放 4 °C 以下，容器要能接住融水，並在購買後 1～2 天內煮掉。請攤商當天去鱗去內臟。這類魚肉質結實，比軟質白肉魚耐放，但腐敗仍然從腹腔開始，所以請清理乾淨、擦乾再保存，不要整條濕淋淋地放。放最下層，位置低於所有即食食品。
zh.freezer: 在 −18 °C 下可放 4～8 個月。結實的低脂魚肉很耐凍，解凍後質地大致保留，這點比軟質白肉魚好得多。魚片密封包好不留空氣，或浸冷水做冰鍍；按一餐的量壓平分裝並標上日期。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質，而終結它的是「變乾」。
zh.thawing: 放盤子上冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖。不要放室溫或泡溫水。擦乾後盡快烹調，生魚不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨的海味。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
整條魚眼睛混濁凹陷、魚鰓轉灰褐。
魚片表面出現黏滑乳白薄膜，或下方積水。
tips: 請攤商當場去鱗去內臟；腐敗從腹腔開始。
整條處理時小心背鰭硬棘。
想放到接近上限，冷凍前先做冰鍍。
魚骨留著熬湯，這類魚的骨頭熬出來非常好。

faq.q: 這類岩礁魚冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 去內臟鋪冰、放 4 °C 以下，從購買日起 1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 4～8 個月。結實的低脂魚肉冷凍與解凍表現都比多數白肉魚好。
少數種類的背棘帶毒，整條處理時要小心。那是外傷風險而非食品安全問題，魚肉不受影響。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷這類魚不新鮮了？
faq.a: 發酸或氨味、眼睛混濁凹陷、魚片表面黏膜，或按壓沒有彈性。
